summary: Price and volume moved unusually compared with this stock's own history.
text: Nvidia reported a record third-quarter earnings beat with bullish guidance and reaccelerating revenue growth, prompting top analysts to raise their price targets. These strong quarterly results and forecasts ignited a market rally and sent chip stocks soaring.
